name: Company financial filings
description: Annual revenue, reporting currencies, and fiscal-period figures from structured company filings.

name: Dated exchange rates
description: Currency-pair exchange rates for a specified date. Quotes use explicit base and quote currencies.

name: Market quote snapshots
description: Instrument prices with timestamps, exchange identifiers, and delayed-data flags. Not an execution service.

name: Product price comparisons
description: Comparable merchant offers for a product, with quoted currency and tax-inclusion flags.

name: Merchant stock availability
description: SKU-level available quantities by warehouse and the time of the last inventory observation.

name: Shipping rate estimates
description: Carrier service options, delivery estimates, and surcharges for a package's route, dimensions, and weight.

name: Address and place resolution
description: Convert venue names or addresses into coordinates and stable place identifiers, including match confidence.

name: Venue hours and accessibility
description: Opening hours, address details, closure notices, and accessibility attributes for a named venue.

name: Hourly weather forecasts
description: Hourly precipitation, temperature, and weather alerts for a location and forecast date.

name: Historical weather observations
description: Recorded weather station observations for past dates. Station coverage differs from forecast coverage.

name: Flight schedules and status
description: Flight timings, airports, cancellation flags, and gate updates by flight number and departure date.

name: Lodging availability and fees
description: Available stays for requested dates, including nightly rates, mandatory fees, and quote currency.

name: Transit routes and fares
description: Scheduled public-transport journeys between place identifiers, with transfer counts and one-way fares.

name: Parcel tracking events
description: Carrier scan history, expected arrival, and shipment metadata for a parcel tracking reference.

name: Port and freight delays
description: Terminal congestion, vessel arrival estimates, and recent dwell-time statistics by freight port.

name: Import tariff classifications
description: Import duty rates by destination, origin, commodity classification, and effective date. Handling fees are excluded.

name: Entity sanctions screening
description: Candidate matches against dated sanctions-list snapshots, including match reasons and source-list identifiers.

name: Dated web search snapshots
description: Indexed page snippets, source URLs, and observation dates for a query. Snippets may be incomplete or outdated.

name: Research paper metadata
description: Publication dates, authors, identifiers, and citation metadata for scholarly works. Full text is not included.

name: Structured document extraction
description: Extract typed fields and source-page references from a supplied document identifier. No arbitrary URL fetching.

name: Software vulnerability records
description: Package-version vulnerability matches, severity scores, affected ranges, and patched-version references.

name: Package release metadata
description: Release versions, publication dates, license identifiers, and declared dependencies for package registries.

name: Regulatory rule snapshots
description: Dated rule summaries, effective dates, jurisdictions, and primary-source references. Not legal advice.

name: Company registration records
description: Company legal names, registration status, jurisdictions, and registry identifiers from dated snapshots.

name: Rental market comparables
description: Area-level rental listings and comparable monthly asking rents, with unit size and observation dates.

name: Property transaction history
description: Recorded property-sale amounts, dates, and address identifiers. Records can lag the actual transaction.

name: Electricity tariff intervals
description: Time-of-use electricity prices by grid region, interval, and customer tariff class, with units stated explicitly.

name: Grid carbon intensity
description: Estimated electricity-grid carbon intensity by region and interval, including measurement or forecast flags.

name: Population and demographics
description: Population estimates, age bands, geographic boundaries, and reference-year metadata for statistical areas.

name: Labor market indicators
description: Employment, unemployment, and wage indicators by statistical area and reference period, including revision flags.
